disclosure: AI-use disclosure: production prompts written by Codex from the requested pixel revision. These specifications are not generated images.
shared_prompt: Original production pixel art for The Ninth Life. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, limited shared palette, no antialiasing. Teal moonlight and restrained violet magic, dark indigo stone. Preserve broad silhouettes and accessory readability at gameplay scale. No copied characters or compositions.
negative_prompt: 3D render, photorealism, painterly texture, smooth gradients, antialiasing, blurry pixels, inconsistent pixel sizes, text, labels, logos, watermark, interface, extra limbs, clipped ears, clipped tail, repeated accessories, background baked into sprites
submission_rule: Submit shared_prompt plus the selected asset prompt plus the matching geometry prompt. Include negative_prompt. Each asset remains pending until the actual output is downloaded and validated.

geometry.arena: Native 480x270 side-view composition. Deliver lossless PNG with exact 2x nearest-neighbor upscale to 960x540. Opaque background. Flat combat floor across the lower fifth. Raised throne platform at right and clear left entry. No characters, weapons, text or interface.
geometry.challenger: Transparent animation production sheet, 6 equal columns and 8 equal rows. Every output cell exactly 64x64 pixels, designed on a 32x32 native grid and upscaled 2x nearest-neighbor. Total output 384x512 pixels. Stable foot baseline at 90 percent cell height, centered root, padding for ears, tail, cloth and weapon. Rows: idle, run, attack anticipation, attack release, recovery, evade, hit reaction, defeated or sitting. Six sequential frames per row, left to right. Independently articulate paws, head, tail and cloth. Consistent anatomy and accessories across all 48 cells. No labels or grid lines. True transparent alpha around every sprite. Impact effects are separate.
geometry.immortal: Transparent animation production sheet, 6 equal columns and 8 equal rows. Every output cell exactly 128x128 pixels, designed on a 64x64 native grid and upscaled 2x nearest-neighbor. Total output 768x1024 pixels. Stable foot baseline at 90 percent cell height, centered root, generous padding for crown, ears, tail, cloak and glaive. Rows: idle, shift, attack anticipation, attack release, recovery, ascend, hit reaction, kneel. Six sequential frames per row, left to right. Independently articulate paws, head, tail, cloak and weapon. Consistent anatomy and accessories across all 48 cells. No labels or grid lines. True transparent alpha around every sprite. Impact effects are separate.

integration_notes: Generate one character at a time, validate anatomy and accessory continuity before selecting.
If a generated sheet violates frame geometry, use its selected reference to author animation frames; do not claim unverified generated frames are production ready.
Verify true alpha, exact dimensions, nearest-neighbor pixels, fixed baseline, no clipping, readable action poses and no labels.
Record actual submitted prompt, model, job ID, date, output filename and attribution after generation.
Use identical architecture, camera, floor and platform coordinates for the night and dawn arenas.
